title: A multifunctional antimicrobial peptide with cell-penetrating and beta-lactam-potentiating activities for combating methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae infections.
authors: Zhang, Xiaoxiao; Zhang, Yuxin; Zhang, Xiaoxue; Li, Wenshuai; Hou, Yixin; Wang, Yao; Xu, Lei; Shen, Xihui
journal: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗菌肽X1-3对耐药菌的杀菌与β-内酰胺协同作用，虽涉及DNA结合但非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: The global health crisis posed by New Delhi metallo-beta-lactamase-producing carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (NDM-CRE) and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) underscores the urgent need for novel antimicrobial agents. Natural antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) often suffer from limited modes of action, narrow antimicrobial spectra, and poor cellular permeability. To address these challenges, we engineered X1-3, a rationally designed AMP that exhibits direct bactericidal activity, efficient cell penetration and synergistic potentiation of beta-lactams. METHODS: X1-3 was generated via structure-activity relationship-guided optimization and machine learning-assisted screening, followed by characterization of its physicochemical properties and safety profile. Its antimicrobial and beta-lactam synergistic activities were evaluated against clinical NDM-CRE and MRSA isolates using checkerboard assays, time-kill kinetics, and confocal microscopy. Mechanistic studies combined transcriptomic profiling with flow cytometry, gel retardation, and enzymatic assays to elucidate multimodal actions involving membrane disruption, DNA binding, and specific inhibition of NDM-5 and PBP2a. Intracellular penetration and in vivo therapeutic potential were assessed in RAW264.7 macrophage infection model and murine systemic infection model, respectively. RESULTS: X1-3 exhibits high stability and robust activity against NDM-CRE, MRSA, and vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus, with low resistance induction. Additionally, X1-3 shows a robust anti-virulence profile by inhibiting biofilm formation and eradicating mature biofilms in both NDM-CRE and MRSA. Mechanistic studies revealed that X1-3 induces bacterial death primarily through membrane disruption and multiple synergistic mechanisms (DNA binding and metabolic perturbations). As a beta-lactam adjuvant, X1-3 enhances antibiotic efficacy by disrupting proton motive force (PMF) to suppress efflux pumps and directly targeting NDM-CRE- and MRSA-associated resistance enzymes, including NDM and penicillin-binding protein 2a (PBP2a). Furthermore, it penetrates host cells via lipid raft-mediated internalization to eradicate intracellular pathogens and attenuate inflammation. In vivo, the combination of X1-3 with beta-lactam antibiotics showed promising therapeutic potential with no observable systemic toxicity. Notably, the treatment effectively alleviated the MRSA-infected wound. CONCLUSIONS: Rational structural optimization enables X1-3 to function as both a direct bactericide and a beta-lactam adjuvant. This dual strategy significantly improves efficacy against clinical NDM-CRE and MRSA, offering a novel therapeutic paradigm.
abstract_zh: 目的：由产新德里金属-β-内酰胺酶的耐碳青霉烯肠杆菌科细菌（NDM-CRE）和耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）引发的全球健康危机，凸显了对新型抗菌药物的迫切需求。天然抗菌肽（AMPs）常存在作用模式有限、抗菌谱窄及细胞通透性差等问题。为应对这些挑战，我们设计并工程化了X1-3，一种经合理设计的抗菌肽，其具有直接杀菌活性、高效细胞穿透能力及对β-内酰胺类药物的协同增效作用。方法：通过结构-活性关系指导的优化和机器学习辅助筛选生成X1-3，随后对其理化性质及安全性进行表征。采用棋盘法、时间-杀菌动力学和共聚焦显微镜评估其对临床NDM-CRE和MRSA分离株的抗菌及β-内酰胺协同活性。机制研究结合转录组学分析、流式细胞术、凝胶阻滞和酶学检测，以阐明涉及膜破坏、DNA结合及对NDM-5和PBP2a特异性抑制的多模式作用。分别在RAW264.7巨噬细胞感染模型和小鼠全身感染模型中评估其胞内穿透能力及体内治疗潜力。结果：X1-3对NDM-CRE、MRSA及耐万古霉素肠球菌表现出高稳定性和强效活性，且耐药诱导率低。此外，X1-3通过抑制生物膜形成并清除NDM-CRE和MRSA的成熟生物膜，展现出强大的抗毒力特性。机制研究表明，X1-3主要通过膜破坏及多种协同机制（DNA结合和代谢扰动）诱导细菌死亡。作为β-内酰胺佐剂，X1-3通过破坏质子动力势（PMF）抑制外排泵，并直接靶向NDM-CRE和MRSA相关耐药酶（包括NDM和青霉素结合蛋白2a（PBP2a）），从而增强抗生素疗效。此外，其通过脂筏介导的内化进入宿主细胞，清除胞内病原体并减轻炎症。在体内，X1-3与β-内酰胺类抗生素联用显示出良好的治疗潜力，且未观察到明显全身毒性。值得注意的是，该治疗有效缓解了MRSA感染伤口。结论：合理的结构优化使X1-3兼具直接杀菌剂和β-内酰胺佐剂功能。这种双重策略显著提高了对临床NDM-CRE和MRSA的疗效，提供了一种新型治疗范式。
